text: With one shared metric definition in hand, now we draw a hard line: what ships in this first version, and what gets logged for later instead of silently dropped.

The foundation ships now: governed active and engaged member metrics, plus revenue reconciled to that same basis. Derived metrics like churn scoring and lifetime value wait -- they need a trustworthy foundation under them first.
Everything deferred gets a reason, not a shrug, and a visible spot on the next version's backlog -- so a good idea raised in this meeting doesn't just evaporate.

Rebuild order matters too: Finance's report first, since it's most board-visible, then Marketing once the engaged-member metric exists on its own, then Product once the duplicate-count fix is validated.
Scope and sequence, both signed off. Next: the first real architecture decision -- why this problem needs a new layer, not one more view.
